sentences.text:
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of.
1. By way of present petition filed under Section 482 Cr.PC, the petitioners seek quashing of FIR No.236/2019 registered under Sections 420/468/471 IPC at PS Malviya Nagar.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners states that connected FIR is also sought to be quashed vide Crl. M.C. No.3/2024, which is now coming up for consideration before HMJ Anoop Kumar Mendiratta on 08.05.2024.

3. In view of the above, subject to the orders of Hon'ble the Acting Chief Justice, list the present petition before HMJ Anoop Kumar Mendiratta on 08.05.2024 along with Crl. M.C. No.03/2024.
4.
In the meantime, let notice be issued to respondent No.2 by all permissible modes, returnable on said date.
